title: Co-cultivation effects of Lactobacillus plantarum and Pichia pastoris on the key aroma components and non-volatile metabolites in fermented jujube juice
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10653-10662
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00193E, Paper
Open Access

Tao Feng, Weitong Cai, Wei Sun, Shixing Yu, Jianhua Cao, Min Sun, Huatian Wang, Chuang Yu, Wencui Kang, Lingyun Yao
Jujube juice was prepared for dynamic fermentation. GC-MS-O, sensory evaluation, and LC-MS identified sensory attribute words and key flavor compounds. Pearson's correlation analysis showed correlations between key aroma compounds and metabolites. The main metabolic pathway of FJJ was plotted.
